dedupe_keys.name: database of breach and runout characteristics from historical tailings dam failures 12 events

description: This database gathers observed characteristics of 12 tailings dam breach events, focused on what numerical modellers need: outflow volumes, breach processes, breach geometries and runout observations downstream. The Borealis page lists breach and runout observation tables, a README, supplemental content and, per event, zipped shapefiles of runout regions, depth points, arrival-time points or polylines with Google Earth KMZ files, for Prestavel, Gillibrand Pond, Harmony 4A, Aznalcollar, Tashan, MAL Reservoir X (Ajka), Kayakari, Mount Polley, Fundao, Tonglushan, Cadia and Feijao. It supplements the 2023 Mine Water and the Environment paper by Adria and co-authors on implications for numerical modelling. Version 1.1 was updated on 18 November 2025, with downloadable files free under CC BY 4.0 and global coverage (a UBC Research Data copy has its own DOI). Caveats: only 12 events are covered and the observation types differ by event, so not every case has depths or arrival times. For simulation it gives calibration and validation targets for dam breach and runout models, such as inundation extents, flow depths and arrival times, and inputs for back-analysis of new events. Related catalogue records include the global database of tailings flows, the Global Tailings Portal and the WISE chronology of tailings dam failures.
